Sam CSM: Heads-up: new customer Mediloop goes live in 12h. Finance worried about demo latency + renewal in 45 days. They use short streaming queries.

Lara CS-Ops: I'll draft a one-page customer runbook with copy/paste toggles: prefill, batching, streaming fallback, minimal telemetry for renewal reporting.

Ben SRE: Quick context: model = 7B-quant, streaming enabled. What are acceptable p95/p99 targets for them? That guides warm-pool sizing.

Sam CSM: Goals: p95 < 350ms, p99 < 1s. Current trial observed p99 ~1.6s during demo load.

Hiro Eng: Proposed customer-facing Day0 checklist (copy/paste):

```
1) Prefill: Settings -> Performance -> Enable warm_pool; set prefill.intents = [greet,search,faq]; cadence = 30m.
2) Warm slots: start with 3 slots; request CS-warmup assist if you want Redwood to run warmup for 72h.
3) Client batching: client_window_ms = 25 (jitter +/-10ms) ; max_batch = 40. Alt: for spiky UX use window = 10ms, max_batch = 24.
4) Prefix caching: session_ttl = 10m; templates_ttl = 1h.
5) Streaming fallback: stream_threshold_ms = 700 -> switch to fallback_model = "7B-lite" if exceeded.
6) Telemetry: export p50,p95,p99,token_cost to CSV at T-24h and T+48h for renewal report.
```

Lara CS-Ops: Internal CS checklist (short): run 8 prefills post-deploy, verify warm slots active, run 5 synthetic requests per intent, validate p95 < 350ms and p99 < 1s, note token cost delta.

Ben SRE: Ops commands customers can share if they approve Redwood assist: `rbnctl warmup --tenant mediloop --slots 3 --intents top_intents.json --at 03:30` and health probe `rbnctl health --tenant mediloop --route /generate --samples 5`.

Amir PM: For renewal risk, ask customer to share the CSV (timestamp,route,p50_ms,p95_ms,p99_ms,tokens,requests,error_rate) daily for 3 days. If p99 improves >30% we mark risk reduced.

task-bot: scheduled warmup job for tenant mediloop at 2026-03-25T03:30:00Z (3 slots) created by Lara CS-Ops

Sam CSM: This is great. Lara — can you turn the Day0 checklist + CSV template into a one-page PDF for the kickoff? I'll request warm-pool assist permission during the call.

Lara CS-Ops: Will do. Attaching PDF here after conversion. Also adding a safety: auto-scale-down warm_pool after 72h no-traffic to prevent cost drift.

Sam CSM: Thanks team — sharing straight to the customer in the kickoff. We'll capture metrics and update renewal board after 48h. :rocket:
